MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH p,i,coalesce(i.timeOriginalEstimateS,0) AS e, collect(l.seconds) AS ls
WITH p,i,e,reduce(s=0,x IN ls|s+x) AS lg
RETURN p.projectKey AS id, sum(lg)-sum(e) AS value

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,l WHERE l IS NOT NULL OR i.timeOriginalEstimateS IS NOT NULL
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, l.historyId AS time_entry
